title: Elf Bar 600 Cherry Cola Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed for use with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pods offer a seamless way to enjoy outstanding flavour and satisfaction without the waste and expense caused by single-use disposables. Each 2ml prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on personal usage, and contains 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw and rapid nicotine relief. Cherry Cola Flavour: A rich and nostalgic blend of bold cherry and classic cola. The deep, juicy cherry notes complement the caramel-like sweetness of cola, with a subtle fizzy sensation that lingers on the exhale. Swapping pods is quick and hassle-free—just click a fresh one into place and vape. Whether you're switching from disposables or looking for a more cost-effective way to enjoy your favourite Elf Bar flavours, these prefilled pods deliver exceptional taste in a convenient, replaceable format.
